subject: Re: Venue badge sync & HubSpot field mapping for Brightwave demo floor
messages:
From: Rohit Singh <rohit.singh@brightwave.io>
To: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Anita Zhao <anita.zhao@brightwave.io>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Venue badge sync — sample payload + opt-in language

Hi Lauren,

Great chatting earlier — excited to support Redwood’s offsite demo on Aug 12. I’m attaching the scanner spec and a proposed opt-in copy (opt-in-language_v3.docx).

High-level: our badge readers emit a small JSON payload per scan with timestamp, badge_id, first_name, last_name, email (if present), company, and opt_in_flags (a bitmask our team uses for consent). We’ll hand you an SFTP drop and a webhook option — whichever you prefer.

Questions for you so we can ship the mapping:
- Do you want raw badge_id stored in HubSpot or matched to an existing device ID?
- Which HubSpot properties should we populate for consent? (we can send boolean fields: marketing_opt_in, demo_followup)
- Any required field transformations (name splitting, company normalization)?

We’ve also attached a starter CSV mapping we typically use. If you can route this to the HubSpot owner and confirm property internal names, we’ll set up a test dump next Tuesday.

Attachments: badge-scanner-specs.pdf, opt-in-language_v3.docx, hubspot-field-mapping.csv

Thanks,
Rohit Singh
Head of Integrations — Brightwave Events
rohit.singh@brightwave.io
+1 (415) 555-0198


From: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
To: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Venue badge sync — sample payload + opt-in language

Team — forwarding Brightwave’s spec. Key asks: map their payload into HubSpot, confirm which HubSpot props we’ll populate, and finalize the opt-in copy for the onsite badge scanner UI.

Quick asks from product/ops perspective:
- Ben: can you validate the CSV mapping and confirm if we store raw badge_id or transform? We prefer to store raw and use device join later, but check long-term dedupe implications.
- Marissa: review the opt-in copy for compliance and customer experience. The event team wants a single-line checkbox on the scanner screen. Any legal flags?
- Camila: confirm the HubSpot owner and whether we can use a workflow to tag records as event_lead:true when they come from Brightwave. Also please confirm the HubSpot property internal names — Rohit attached a starter mapping but it uses different labels.

Plan: If we align by EOD Tuesday (21 Jul), request Brightwave to push a small test file Wed morning and we’ll validate the ingest to the sandbox HubSpot account.

Thanks — Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Sr. Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com

On Sat, Jul 18, 2026 at 9:12 AM Rohit Singh <rohit.singh@brightwave.io> wrote:
> Great chatting earlier — excited to support Redwood’s offsite demo on Aug 12...

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Venue badge sync — sample payload + opt-in language

Lauren / team — I reviewed the CSV mapping and ran it against our sandbox HubSpot. Notes: 
- We should ingest badge_id to a custom property raw_badge_id (string). Storing raw is fine — we can link to devices later.
- Map first_name/last_name -> firstname / lastname (HubSpot defaults). For email, we’ll attempt dedupe on email first, then fallback to raw_badge_id when email absent.
- For consent: create two boolean properties: event_marketing_opt_in (true/false) and demo_followup_ok (true/false). Brightwave’s opt_in_flags bitmask will be decoded at ingest; I’ll add the decode step in the ingestion lambda.
- Company normalization: set company_normalized by applying our existing normalization table (I’ll run a dry job on the test dump).

I’m attaching hubspot-field-mapping.csv with the internal property names we used in the sandbox. Also setting up a small test pipeline that will write to a HubSpot sandbox portal (company ID in the Drive link Rohit shared).

Reminders / open items:
1) Marissa — confirm opt-in phrasing so we can push final copy back to Brightwave (they asked for on-screen checkbox text).
2) Camila — after you confirm which HubSpot portal & user we should use, I’ll request API keys for the sandbox and schedule the test ingest for Wed morning.

Attachments: hubspot-field-mapping.csv

—Ben
Ben Carter
Lead Integrations Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com

From: Rohit Singh <rohit.singh@brightwave.io>

Thanks everyone — this is great. Confirming next steps from Brightwave side: 
- We’ll flip to send the Wed 22 Jul test dump to the SFTP and fire the webhook at 09:00 PT.
- We’ll use the opt-in copy in opt-in-language_v3.docx but changed the checkbox label to the short copy Marissa provided ("Yes — I agree to be contacted about product demos and related content"). Please confirm final copy before Wed 08:00 PT.
- DocuSign: sending a short MSA addendum for data handling/retention — link to follow.

I’ll post the test webhook payload to the Drive folder and include a small sample file so Ben can validate the decode. If anyone wants a quick 20-min test call Wed 09:30 PT after the webhook, we can run through ingestion logs together.

Thanks — Rohit
